component.name: User Service Manager
component.summary: Review and manage your systemd user services

description.p: A calm GNOME application for reviewing and managing explicitly registered user services.
Clarify the supported user-service scope, future concepts, and features that are not planned.
Add validated drop-in management, change previews, and reversible service deletion and restoration.
Add validated creation and editing of systemd user service files, optional backups, conflict detection, and safe reload integration.
Refine the main header and show the managed-service count.
